title: I SPEAK FAVOUR OVER MY MORNING AND EVERYTHING I TOUCH TODAY IN JESUS NAME
text: There is something happening in the atmosphere right now, and I need everybody in this place to lay down whatever you carried in here with you. Lay it down because heaven did not open today for you to sit and observe. Heaven opened for you to receive. Somebody just lift your hands where you are. Lift them high. Not because I said so, but because something in your spirit already knows this is not an ordinary gathering. I perceive there is a company of people here whose hands have been tired, tired of working without result, >> [music] >> tired of sowing without harvest, tired of stretching forth and receiving nothing back. I want to tell you before we go any further, that pattern ends today. Somewhere in the unseen, angels have been assigned and dispatched, and they are not looking for the loudest voice in the room. They are looking for the hungriest heart. So, if your heart is hungry this morning, if something in you has been crying underneath your composure, let it cry a little louder now because heaven answers hunger, not performance. Do you feel that? Something just shifted. There is a difference between a service that is organized and a service that is invaded. I am not interested in organizing your emotions today. I am contending [music] for an invasion because what you need is not a nice message to write in your notebook and forget by Wednesday. What you need is contact, actual contact with the living God. So, that when you leave here, your hands will not be the same, your mouth will not be the same, your feet will not be the same. Let's go to the book of Genesis chapter 39 verse 3. The scripture says concerning Joseph, "And his master saw that the Lord was with him, and that the Lord made all that he did to prosper in his hand." Hold that phrase, in his hand. Not in his title, not in his connections, not in his paperwork, in his hand. Meaning, whatever Joseph's hand touched carried the fingerprint of heaven's approval on it. He could be sold as a slave and his hand would still prosper. He could be thrown into a prison house and his hand would still prosper. Why? Because the anointing was not on his position, the anointing was on his hand. I need you to hear this. There are people whose blessing is tied to their office, so the moment the office is taken, the blessing disappears. But there is a class of believer that heaven is raising today whose blessing is tied to their hand. Wherever that hand goes, whatever that hand does, whoever that hand serves, prosperity follows because favor has taken residence in the hand itself. Somebody shout, "My hand is a carrier." Now, come with me to Psalm 90:17. And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us and establish thou the work of our hands upon us. Yea, the work of our hands establish thou it. Notice Moses, the man who saw the back of God's glory, the man who parted seas by the authority of a rod in his hand. This same Moses is praying. Establish the work of our hands. If Moses needed to pray this prayer, then nobody in this house is exempted from praying it. You cannot assume your hand into blessing. You must decree contend for it and let heaven establish it. So, here's what we're going to do. We are not just going to read about favor, we're going to open our mouths and we're going to speak because Proverbs 18:21 says, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue." Your mouth is not just for eating and talking. Your mouth is a distribution center for destiny. Whatever you release from that mouth today, heaven is going to back up with fire. Say this with me loud. I speak favor over my hands, my mouth, my steps, and everything I touch today in Jesus' name. Again, louder. I speak favor over my hands, my mouth, my steps, and everything I touch today in Jesus' name. There is a difference between saying a thing and decreeing a thing. When you decree a thing, Job 22:28 says, "It shall be established unto you, and light shall shine upon your ways." So, this is not motivational speech. This is a legal decree from a covenant child of God, and heaven is obligated to respond to covenant language. I see hands in this house that have been closed by disappointment. Somebody applied for something and got rejected three times. Somebody's hand has planted seed after seed into business, into ministry, into relationships, and it feels like the ground swallowed the seed and gave nothing back. I decree over that hand right now, you will not labor in vain again. Isaiah 65:23 says, "They shall not labor in vain, nor bring forth for trouble." Not this season, not for you. Let the fire fall on every hand that has been closed by frustration. Let the fire fall on every mouth that has spoken defeat over itself out of pain. Let the fire fall on every step that has walked in circles, going nowhere, arriving nowhere. I decree every closed hand open now in the name of Jesus. Every hand that has been shrinking back because of shame, receive boldness now. I want you to understand something about favor before we go into full warfare. Favor is not luck. Favor is not chance. Favor, biblically, is the manifestation of divine partiality released upon a life because of covenant relationship. Esther chapter 2:15 says, "She obtained favor in the sight of all them that looked upon her." Watch this. Esther did nothing spectacular to earn that favor in that verse. It says she simply required nothing but what was appointed. In other words, she walked in what God had already ordained and favor did the rest of the work. That means some of you are not lacking effort, you are lacking alignment. You have been trying to hustle a blessing that was already appointed for you and all heaven is asking you to do is align, decree, and walk in it. There is a woman here today and I sense the spirit of God highlighting a matter concerning your hands. Specifically, you work with your hands whether in a trade, a craft, a kitchen, a service, and there has been a spirit assigned to make your labor look small in the eyes of others. I break that assignment now. I decree that what your hands produce will begin to speak for itself. And men and women who never noticed you before will suddenly seek you out. Genesis 41:40, "Pharaoh said to Joseph, 'According unto thy word, shall all my people be ruled.'" Yesterday's prisoner became today's prime minister by the same hand that was once shackled. There's fire falling in this place right now. Somebody receive it. Let's talk about the mouth for a moment because your mouth carries more authority than you have been taught. Matthew 12:37 says, "For by thy words thou shall be justified. And by thy words, thou shalt be condemned. This is not talking about unbelievers. Jesus said this to people who already had covenant with God. Meaning, your words can either activate or deactivate the blessing that is legally yours. Some of you have been confessing defeat out of habit. "Nothing works for me. I'm always the one who suffers. It's just my portion." I need you to hear me stop authorizing evil with your own mouth. Repent of every careless word that has given legal ground to the enemy over your life. Say it, "My mouth is a weapon, not a wound." Say it again, "My mouth releases blessing, not bondage." Now, let's go deeper because there's a category of people here whose steps have felt cursed. You walk into rooms and doors close. You apply for the visa and it's denied. You walk into the relationship and it collapses. You walk into the business meeting and something always goes wrong right before the deal closes. I want you to know something. Psalm 37:23 says, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he delighted in his way." Ordered steps do not stumble into accidents. Ordered steps arrive on purpose, on time, into rooms that were prepared before the foundation of the world. So, right now, I want to prophesy over the steps in this house. I decree every door that has been mysteriously shutting against you, open now by fire. I decree every appointment that was sabotaged in the spirit realm before it reached the natural, is restored now. I decree your feet will begin to walk into rooms that were reserved for you before you were born. Somebody give God a shout of violent praise right now because we are not playing church. We are contending for territory. I want us to move into a place of deep prayer now because prophecy without prayer is just noise but prophecy followed by warfare is a weapon. So, everybody wherever you are, posture yourself. Some of you need to stand. Some of you need to kneel. Some of you just need to lift your hands and open your mouth because we're about to press into the realm of the spirit and pull down what belongs to us. Father, in the name of Jesus, we thank you for the fire that has already begun to move in this place. We thank you that you are not a God who watches from a distance. You are a God who invades. Lord, we ask you now to open the heavens over every hand, every mouth, and every step represented in this gathering. I speak to every hand right now in the name of Jesus. Receive the anointing for exploits. Daniel 11:32 says, "The people that do know their God shall be strong and do exploits." Not survive, not manage, exploits. I decree that your hand will do what other hands have failed to do. Where others tried and failed, your hand will succeed because the anointing on you is not common. Let every evil hand that has been raised against your hand wither now in Jesus' name. Let every witchcraft manipulation assigned to sabotage the work of your hands be exposed AND DESTROYED BY FIRE. I call forth destiny restoration in this house right now. Somebody's destiny was hijacked at a point, maybe in the womb, maybe in childhood, maybe through a bad decision, maybe through another person's wickedness. I decree by the authority of Jeremiah 29:11, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." Every hijacked destiny is recovered now. Every file that was closed prematurely in the spirit realm is reopened by fire. Malaka baraka deshu tokorai amena fashu ran I say lukobara am wanasha dekolimbe. I feel a release happening right now over families in this house. There is a household represented here that has been under a spirit of scattering where everybody in the family seems to be pulling in a different direction, where there is no peace, where the enemy has planted seeds of division between parents and children, between siblings, between husband and wife. I decree every altar of scattering erected against your family is pulled down now in the name of Jesus. Let the God who sets the solitary in families, according to Psalm 68:6, gather what has been scattered and restore what has been stolen. I pray for marriages in this place. For the married, let every spirit of strife, suspicion, and silent bitterness that has crept into your union be cast out now by fire. For those praying for marriage, I decree, according to Proverbs 18:22, "Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing and obtaineth favor of the Lord." Your season of waiting is closing. And your season of finding begins now. Let every satanic delay assigned to your marital destiny be terminated in Jesus' name. I decree divine connections over singles in this house, connections that will not waste your time, connections that carry destiny, not distraction. Let's move into finances because I sense there are people here whose hands have been working, but the wealth has not been coming. I want you to understand Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "Thou shalt remember the Lord thy God for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth. Power to get wealth is a spiritual empowerment before it is a natural strategy. So, right now, I release power to get wealth upon every hand in this house. I decree every financial gate that has been shut against you by generational poverty be broken open now. I decree every contract, every deal, every deposit that has been delayed in transit in the spirit realm locate you now in Jesus' name. I curse the spirit of the almost almost got the job, almost closed the deal, almost received the payment. I curse that spirit at the root, and I decree that what has been almost for you becomes accomplished from today. Malachi 3:10, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." I decree windows, not doors, because a door opens for one person to walk through, but a window pours in torrents. Let the windows of heaven be flung open over your finances. Somebody clap your hands and thank God, because I sense breakthrough is not far from this place. Now, let's contend for health and healing, because favor is not just about money. Favor is about the wholeness of your life. There is somebody here carrying a report in your body that the enemy has been using to intimidate you. I decree by the stripes of Jesus according to Isaiah 53:5, "He was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities, the chastisement of our peace was upon him, and with his stripes we are healed." Every sickness assigned to weaken your hand and slow your step is destroyed now in the name of Jesus. I decree strength returning to weak hands and feeble knees according to Isaiah 35:3. Let every hidden infirmity, every silent affliction, every disease trying to establish itself quietly in a body in this house be flushed out by the fire of the Holy Ghost now. Ashira Kolobe Demanshu Feraki Tonde Amela Baraki Shemele Wandalu Korashi Feme Deba. I sense we need to address covenants and evil altars now because some of the resistance you have been fighting is not random. It is covenantal. Somewhere an altar was raised maybe by an ancestor, maybe by [music] an enemy, maybe through your own past involvement in something you didn't understand the weight of and that altar has been speaking against your hand, your mouth, and your steps. I decree in the name of Jesus every evil altar raised against MY DESTINY CATCH FIRE NOW. NUMBERS 23:23 says, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." I stand on that word and I declare there is no enchantment, no divination, no altar strong enough to hold back what God has purposed for your life. I break every covenant of poverty spoken over your bloodline. I break every covenant of shame, failure, and disgrace tied to your family name. I break every satanic parliament that has convened to discuss and delay your destiny. Let the blood of Jesus speak over every altar and the blood of Jesus speaks better things than the blood of Abel according to Hebrews 12:24. I release angelic intervention over this gathering right now. Psalm 34 verse 7 says the angel of the Lord encamped round about them that fear him and delivered them. I decree angels assigned to your hands begin to work now. Angels assigned to open doors ahead of your steps move now. Angels assigned to silence every voice speaking against your mouth be released now in the name of Jesus. I see angels moving into rooms ahead of some of you board rooms, interview rooms, hospital rooms, court rooms clearing the atmosphere before you even arrive. When you walk in the resistance will have already been dismantled because heaven went ahead of you. Somebody shout I am not walking alone. We must also deal with witchcraft directly because I will not stand here and pretend the enemy is passive. There is organized resistance in the spirit realm against destinies in this house and I will not sugarcoat it. Exodus 22 verse 18 speaks of the reality of witchcraft and Galatians 5 speaks of it as a work of the flesh that opposes the spirit. I decree every witchcraft altar assigned to monitor your hand be scattered by fire now. Every coven that has held meetings concerning your progress catch the fire of the Holy Ghost now and be disbanded. Let every arrow fired against your hands, your mouth and your steps back fire to the sender now in Jesus name. Let every witchcraft padlock placed on doors meant for you melt now by fire. I decree no weapon formed against you shall prosper according to Isaiah 54 verse 17 and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. There is a matter of time and virtue I must address because I sense some of you have lost seasons not because you were lazy, but because things were stolen from you. Joel 2:25 says, "I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten." I decree every year the enemy stole from your assignment is restored now. Every season of delay is compensated for in the name of Jesus. What should have taken you 10 years, God will do in one because time is not your master. God is the master of time. I also decree virtual restoration. Mark chapter 5 tells us of the woman with the issue of blood who touched the hem of Jesus' garment [music] and virtue went out of him and she was made whole. There is virtue that has been drained from some of you through overwork, through toxic relationships, through spiritual attacks you didn't even recognize. I decree every drop of virtue that has been drained from your life return now in the name of Jesus. Be recharged, be renewed, be restored to fullness. I decree divine preservation over everyone in this house. Psalm [music] 121:7-8, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul." The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore. I decree you will not fall victim to any accident assigned against you this season. Your going out is covered, your coming in is covered, your hands are covered, your mouth is covered, your steps are covered. Let me speak now some prophetic words specifically as the spirit leads. There is someone here who has been waiting for a specific phone call. That call is coming within the next few weeks. Do not lose hope. There is someone whose paperwork has been stuck in a system. I see movement happening even now in the spirit realm concerning that document. Somebody here has been praying about a house, a property, a piece of land. I decree that matter is settled in your favor. There is a young person here whose parents have been worried about their direction. I decree clarity is coming and is coming fast. There is someone nursing a private wound from betrayal by someone close. I decree comfort and I decree that the person who betrayed you will not prosper from what they did to you, but you will. There is somebody here whose hands used to create, write, paint, build, design and you stopped because of discouragement. I decree pick up that gift again because that is one of the very things I am releasing favor over today. I feel the weight of God's presence increasing in this place. Somebody who has been silently weeping since this service started, he sees you. This is not by accident. You were led here today. Let's return to declaration because I want this word to leave your mouth until it becomes the final authority over your circumstances. Say it with everything in you. I speak favor over my hands. I speak favor over my mouth. I speak [music] favor over my steps. I speak favor over everything I touch today in Jesus' name. Let every closed hand open. Let every silenced mouth speak boldly. Let every stagnant step begin to move with purpose. I decree that this year they will not recognize you by your struggle. They will recognize you by your testimony. I decree that everywhere your feet have wept, your feet shall now rejoice. I decree that the same hands that were once mocked for their lack shall become hands that other people run to for help. I want to close this ministration in a place of consecration because favor is a covenant reality, not a magic formula. James 4:6 says God resisted the proud but giveth grace, that is favor, to the humble. So, as we receive all that has been decreed today, let's humble ourselves before him because favor flows to hearts that remain low before God even when life exalts them. Father, we thank you for this hour. We thank you for every hand that has been touched, every mouth that has been re-aligned, every step that has been redirected. We ask that from today the evidence of your favor will be undeniable in the lives of everyone who received this word. Let it not just be a feeling that fades by evening. Let it be a reality that manifests in the days ahead in the mighty and matchless name of Jesus we have prayed and we believe. And everybody said, "Amen." Somebody shout it again like you mean it. Amen. Now, go with new hands, a new mouth, and new steps, and let everything you touch from today carry the unmistakable fingerprint of divine favor in Jesus' mighty name.
